notes: The page recalls groups, group actions and homogeneous spaces, the correspondence between pointed homogeneous spaces and subgroups, and conjugacy criteria. It then defines a torsor by unique transport between points, relates this to trivial stabilizers and the regular homogeneous space, and discusses its automorphism group. The underlined title is “Rappels de théorie des groupes et sur espaces homogènes”. There is no date or author page number; the pale lower-left 2 is archival.

The source uses the phi-shaped empty-set sign at both nonempty conditions, literal ∃1, and the abbreviations esp. hom., ss-grpe, ss, sss, comm. and trans. These remain unexpanded. The deletion of que beneath inserted de plus is restored. The diagram label f is on the right of the downward arrow.

In the automorphism paragraph the source writes y=gx, while the ensuing computation uses y=sx. The boxed subscript remains g/s; it is not forced to match the computation. A literal question mark follows the composition circle, and the lower struck implication also carries a question mark.

With ordinary function composition and a left action, the characterization u_x(g)(x)=gx gives u_x(g)∘u_x(h)=u_x(hg), an antihomomorphism. Thus the source’s “iso.” requires an opposite-group/composition convention or an inverse in the characterization. The transcription preserves it. Separately, when y=sx, equivariance gives s u_y(g)x=gsx and hence u_y(g)=u_x(s^{-1}gs); this validates that lower calculation without changing the distinct gx in the prose. These are targeted checks, recorded in CHECK_EVENTS.tsv.

check_events.outcome: For the left action and displayed characterization u_x(g)(x)=gx, equivariance gives u_x(g)(h x)=h g x. Thus u_x(g) composed with u_x(h) equals u_x(hg), so the displayed characterization gives an antihomomorphism under ordinary function composition. The manuscript claim iso. is preserved; an opposite-group/composition convention may be implicit.

If y=sx, equivariance gives s u_y(g)x=u_y(g)(sx)=g sx, hence u_y(g)x=s^{-1}gsx and u_y(g)=u_x(s^{-1}gs). This checks the written lower calculation and identifies the g/s inconsistency to inspect; it does not authorize changing the written prose gx or the g-first boxed subscript.

workflow_notes: Only scan003 packet, common rules/preamble/current notation and its three image files were opened. The full image was viewed once for layout and both supplied halves once each; all source words and symbols, including C/H agreements, were checked.

46 original-coordinate crops were made with PIL autocontrast and LANCZOS enlargement, longest side about 2200 pixels. Each was visually inspected once. Three image emissions were dropped by an output-size limit and were re-emitted before their first visual inspection; no settled crop was re-examined.
The sheet is upright, entirely handwritten in blue ink, with an archival pencil 2 at the lower left. No manuscript page number occurs at the head. No watermark or printed text is transcribed.
Two diagrams are retained: the downward morphism with condition/subgroup correspondence, and the rightward/downward three-way torsor criterion. No standalone drawing occurs.
All 12 C doubt sites have explicit retained/resolved decisions. Struck Les/Le, struck boxed int(g) and crossed implication/question remain doubtful because some strokes merge with cancellations.
The prose gx and the later sx-based calculation are not reconciled. The manuscript question mark after the composition circle is literal text, not an editorial doubt mark.
Mathematical checks below are separate from the ink decisions; neither an opposite-group convention nor the expected change-of-point formula has been substituted into the transcription.
The diagonal relation keeps C's simeq/sim doubt. H's uncertain double arrow is not favored because distinct arrowheads cannot be located.
The numbered lines include diagram rows, isolated comparison marks, three diagonal margin-note lines and the archival corner numeral; line_count is a source-coverage count, not TeX physical lines.
root_review: All 46 saved crops personally inspected, including the complete doubtful boxed formula and lower calculation. The page proposal was checked against those images. The deletion/replacement of que is accepted at high confidence; the unresolved word endings, accent, g/s, and crossed terms remain marked. Source words and glyphs are preserved even where the mathematical convention or indices are problematic.
